messages:
maria: quick PSA — nightly-h100-smoke (job nightly-ml-2026-03-16-03, shard 3) red. Failing test: test_attention_cache_eviction. Sequence: kernel timeout -> Xid 79 -> process killed. Suspect driver/cuda skew after last infra roll. logs:
```
[2026-03-16 03:12:41] ERROR: GPU0: launch failure, Xid 79
[2026-03-16 03:12:41] stack: driver_launch_kernel(...) +0x1a2
[2026-03-16 03:12:41] runtime: CUDA kernel abort, killing process
```
Can someone bisect or request rerun? tagging @infra-team

evan: got it, can you paste full failing container image and driver version?

maria: image: quay.redwood/ml-nightly:h100-20260316
nvidia-driver: 535.104.05
cuda: 12.2

sam: thx. On A100->H100 flips we've seen Xid79 when driver bump + quant kernels. Can you try rerun with driver pinned to 535.104.04? Also try reducing intra-op threads to 1 in test to rule out concurrency.

ana: +1 to rerun. Also run `--test-filter test_attention_cache_eviction` to avoid full-suite cost.

maria: ok starting targeted rerun with pinned driver + threads=1

ci-bot: rerun requested by maria for job nightly-ml-2026-03-16-03 (shard 3). rerun id: 1723456795. status: queued

evan: if rerun still fails, can we capture nv-proc-memory and dmesg before reboot? last time dmesg had 'nvlink timeout' spikes.

maria: noted, will collect dmesg + nv-smi output on next failure. I'll report back with rerun result.

ci-bot: rerun 1723456795 started on h100-node-17

maria: rerun passed with pinned driver. Looks like driver bump introduced regression. Opening infra ticket to block driver rollout and trigger bisect.

sam: sweet. pls include failing kernel logs. I'll start a bisect plan tomorrow.

maria: filing ticket now - link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-3217 :thumbsup:
